title: Quarterly crosswalk: hosted API + model catalog planning
creator: Nina Alvarez
description: Objective: Produce a tight quarterly plan that aligns Hosted API route releases with model-catalog curation windows so we can: 1) avoid mid-quarter regressions caused by mismatched model swaps, 2) reduce unexpected latency/cost spikes during refreshes, and 3) create a repeatable canary and rollback cadence for model swaps. Background: multiple teams have been independently scheduling model updates and hosted endpoint promotions. That has led to two incidents last quarter where a model variant swap without a conforming token-cost profile caused an increase in tail latency and customer cost. This ticket is the PM-level crosswalk to establish the quarter-by-quarter choreography, decision gates, and OKR mapping. Deliverables: a) quarterly calendar mapping model-catalog release windows to Hosted API commit lanes, b) canary scheduling template (timebox, traffic cohorts, metrics to watch), c) gating checklist for model compatibility (quantization profile, KV-cache behavior, seq-length perf), d) responsibilities matrix (who approves swaps, who monitors), and e) a demo-run simulation plan for Q2. Success metrics/OKRs: link plan to OKRs - reduce hosted-model swap incidents to 0 per quarter; reduce median tail latency delta from baseline by 15% for swapped models; reduce unit cost increase from swaps to < 5% on average. Scope: Hosted API routes and the Model Catalog only (Dedicated and Private follow-on playbook in Q3). Non-goals: real-time runtime kernel changes, on-prem deployment specifics.
acceptance_criteria: Quarterly calendar published and synced with Engineering, Design, and Support

OKR mapping added to the quarterly tracker and owners assigned

risks: Model catalog cadence misalignment with infra capacity leading to degraded latency
Incomplete quality signals for some models (lack of eval prompts) causing false-negative canaries
Operational burden on SRE during concentrated swap windows
mitigations: Stagger model promotions across tranche windows with automated traffic hedging
Require minimum eval-set coverage and baseline quality pass before canary promotion
Schedule swap windows during low-traffic regional windows and pre-book Dedicated burst capacity when needed

Mar 1 - Mar 7: Draft calendar and gating checklist (this ticket due)
Mar 8 - Mar 21: Two dry-run simulations with telemetry collection
Mar 22 - Mar 28: Review and sign-off, add to quarterly tracker
decisions: Adopt a 3-stage canary (0.5% / 5% / 25%) for hosted model promotions
Require quantization compatibility verification step in the model onboarding checklist
Use the hostedapi-modelcatalog-2025.Q2 release lane for any swaps during the quarter
